description: A shell script for self-healing network connectivity, including ping tests, DNS resolution checks, and router resets.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay before starting the ping test.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking a simulated reboot command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Performs a reset if the process name is PING.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution test and triggers corrective action if needed.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network ping test to default gateway and triggers reset on failure.
